note: Messages the Employees tab sends (10 Sep audit): the transfer order with its acknowledgement link, the acknowledgement itself, probation milestone reminders to HR and the reporting manager, and the confirmation note. Queued through Surface\Notifications with a dedupe key per employee and per milestone, so a sweep that runs twice sends once. Nothing is transmitted until a transport is declared — see config/notifications.json.

transfer.approved.title: Your transfer order — effective {effective}
transfer.approved.body: {name} ({code}): your {type} transfer to {to} is approved, effective {effective}. Reason: {reason}. Please acknowledge the transfer order: {link}
transfer.approved.audience_note: The person being moved. The approver just decided it.

transfer.acknowledged.title: Transfer acknowledged by {name}
transfer.acknowledged.body: {name} ({code}) acknowledged the transfer order effective {effective} on {when}.

probation.reminder.title: Probation ends in {days} day(s): {name}
probation.reminder.body: {name} ({code}), {designation}, {company}: probation ends on {end} ({days} day(s) left). Confirm or extend it on People → Probation; confirming asks which of PF, ESI, PT, LWF and TDS apply from then on.
probation.reminder.audience_note: The roles named in Probation → Who is told (Admin and HR Admin by default), and the reporting manager when the company's settings say so. One message per milestone crossed.

probation.last_day.title: Probation ends TODAY: {name}
probation.last_day.body: {name} ({code}), {designation}, {company}: today, {end}, is the last day of probation. Confirm or extend it on People → Probation — remarks are required either way.
probation.last_day.audience_note: Sent on the last day itself (the 0-day milestone) instead of a "0 day(s) left" reminder.

probation.overdue.title: Probation overdue: {name}
probation.overdue.body: {name} ({code}) passed the probation end date {end} and is neither confirmed nor extended. Every month unnoticed is a month of wrong statutory deductions.
probation.overdue.audience_note: HR always; the reporting manager when Probation Settings says so.

probation.confirmed.title: Congratulations — you are confirmed
probation.confirmed.body: Dear {name}, your probation is complete and you are confirmed as a permanent employee with effect from {on}. Welcome aboard.
probation.confirmed.audience_note: Sent only when Probation Settings turns on the congratulations note.
